text: The Saab 9000 was produced from 1984 to 1998. The turbocharged 2.0L engine produced 150 hp, while the 2.3L turbo made 200 hp. The Aero variant had a 2.3L turbo producing 225 hp.
BitNet b1.58 is a 1-bit large language model where every weight is ternary: -1, 0, or 1. It matches full-precision transformer performance while being significantly more efficient for inference.
The ASUS TUF GeForce RTX 5070 Ti features 16GB of GDDR7 memory, based on NVIDIA's Blackwell architecture, with approximately 22 TFLOPS of fp16 performance.

Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) combines a retrieval system with a language model. The retriever fetches relevant documents from a knowledge base, which are then provided as context to the LLM for generating accurate answers.
